title: Disentangling Perception and Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs via Reward Design
abstract: arXiv:2601.00215v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has driven major gains in LLM reasoning, and it is intuitive to assume this recipe will transfer well to multimodal models. However, multimodal models do two things: first, perceive what is in an image, then reason about what it implies. Because these stages are graded jointly, it is hard to tell how much room reasoning alone has to grow. We study this on algorithmic visual puzzles, where both components are necessary and show that perception, not reasoning, is the binding constraint. Replacing images with simple textual descriptions raises performance by over 20 points on average for Claude models. We then evaluate six reward designs aimed at inducing visual grounding during reasoning without chain-of-thought supervision. Training Qwen-2.5-VL-7B with GRPO, reward design induces long, structured reasoning with self-reflection and visual references, yielding a 5.56-point gain over t

translated_title: 通过奖励设计解耦多模态大语言模型中的感知与推理
translated_abstract: 带可验证奖励的强化学习已在大语言模型推理方面带来了重大提升，人们直觉上认为这一方法能很好地迁移到多模态模型中。然而，多模态模型需要做两件事：首先感知图像中的内容，然后对其含义进行推理。由于这两个阶段是联合评分的，很难判断单靠推理还有多大的提升空间。我们在算法视觉谜题上研究了这一问题——这类任务同时需要感知和推理两个组件——结果表明，制约性能的瓶颈是感知而非推理。用简单的文本描述替换图像，可使Claude模型的性能平均提升超过20分。随后，我们评估了六种旨在在推理过程中诱导视觉锚定的奖励设计，且无需思维链监督。使用GRPO训练Qwen-2.5-VL-7B时，奖励设计能诱导出带有自我反思和视觉引用的长而结构化的推理，相比（原文截断）……取得5.56分的性能提升。
tldr: 该研究发现多模态大模型在算法视觉谜题上的性能瓶颈在于感知而非推理，并通过奖励设计在无思维链监督的情况下诱导视觉锚定推理，使Qwen-2.5-VL-7B提升5.56分。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that perception, not reasoning, is the binding constraint for multimodal LLMs on algorithmic visual puzzles, and proposes reward designs that induce visual grounding without chain-of-thought supervision, yielding a 5.56-point gain for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B.
